posts.title: Donald Farquharson of Monaltrie’s Highland Regiment of Foot
posts.description: Technically the third of two promised new Scottish units. If sci-fi writers can have four part trilogies, I can have three of two. If you think that is slightly confusing, the rest of this post continues in the same vein...
